description: This file defines the 'EcuAddress' interface with methods related to ECU address information, including getAddresses(), getBytes(), getBit(), and getLength().

classes.name: EcuAddress
classes.description: A Java interface for ECU address-related functionalities, specifying methods to retrieve addresses, bytes, bit position, and length.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns an array of address strings associated with the ECU.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns a byte array representing the ECU address data.

methods.name: getBit
methods.description: Returns the bit index within the address.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the address data.
